I am an old woman, 71 years, and I farm this small piece of land alone with help from my grandchildren. If I get the coupon from FISP this year, I will use a little NPK and urea on my maize, but only a small amount because my plot is small and my strength is little. I keep some chickens and goats, so I put their manure on the field before the rains. I plant the maize together with pigeon pea and pumpkins like I have always done, and I save seed from last year because hybrid seed is expensive when the coupon does not come.
